description_full:
"📢 WE ARE HIRING INTERNS! 📢

Are you passionate about education and love working with children? ✨

Active Araya Edu Centre is looking for enthusiastic and dedicated students to join our Internship Program as an English Assistant Teacher! 🎓📚

Gain valuable experience, develop your teaching skills, and be part of a fun and supportive learning environment while helping children on their English learning journey! 💙

📌 Requirements:

Currently enrolled university students from all majors (English Education or related fields preferred).
Have an interest in education and working with children.
Possess basic to intermediate English skills.
Communicative, patient, creative, and responsible.
Willing to learn and work collaboratively in a team.
Able to participate according to the internship schedule.
📍 Work Location: East Surabaya

📝 Apply Now! Scan the QR code on the poster or visit: https://tinyurl.com/Active-Edu-Centre

📞 Contact Us: +62 813 6004 6800 📧 actedcsby@gmail.com 📸 Instagram: @activeeducentre.sby

Don't miss this opportunity to learn, grow, and make a difference! 🌟

Join us and be part of our educational journey!

"
